# Pixel Puzzle Swap

A simple, offline browser-based puzzle game. Swap adjacent tiles on a 4x4 grid to make each row a single color. The game counts your swaps and shows "Solved!" when you win. A Shuffle button starts a new puzzle.

## Features

- 4x4 grid of colored tiles (4 colors)
- Click or tap two adjacent tiles to swap them
- Swap counter
- Solved detection (each row must be a single color)
- Shuffle button to start a new puzzle
- Keyboard accessible: use arrow keys to move focus, Enter/Space to select, Escape to cancel
- Fully responsive from 360px width
- No external dependencies, network requests, or assets

## How to Play

1. Open `index.html` in any modern browser.
2. Click or tap a tile to select it (it will highlight).
3. Click or tap an adjacent tile to swap them.
4. Continue swapping until every row has only one color.
5. The swap counter tracks your moves, and "Solved!" appears when you win.
6. Press the Shuffle button to start a new random puzzle at any time.

### Keyboard Controls

- **Arrow keys**: Move focus between tiles
- **Enter / Space**: Select a tile or swap with the currently selected adjacent tile
- **Escape**: Cancel selection

## Files

- `index.html` – Main page structure
- `style.css` – Styling and responsive layout
- `script.js` – Game logic
